name: aladdin.breakpoints
description: Canonical responsive breakpoints (min-width). Reconciled to UI_UX_SYSTEM_GUIDE.md canonical viewports; supersedes the provisional 1080/1360 values from the local .impeccable sidecar.
maintenance: Manually maintained. Edit here first, then frontend/tailwind.config.ts (theme.extend.screens).

mobile.usage: Base (mobile-first). Stacked layouts, off-canvas nav, bottom actions.

tablet.usage: Two-column where it helps; sidebar may become a drawer or rail.

desktop.usage: Persistent workspace sidebar; split-panel auth; full tables.

wide.usage: Wider content column / max-width caps; not a new layout.

rules.intentional-layouts: Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop are intentional layouts, not compressed copies. Reflow, don't shrink.
rules.no-horizontal-scroll: The page body never scrolls horizontally; wide content scrolls within its own container.
rules.test-both: Test every breakpoint in both LTR and RTL and both themes.
